\begin{document}
Let $x$ and $a$ be real. Summing over both signs,
\begin{equation}
\sum_{s=\pm} \frac{s}{x - s a} = \frac{2a}{x^2-a^2}
\label{eq:s1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\sum\limits_{\pm} \left(\frac{1}{x \mp a}\right) = \frac{2x}{x^2-a^2}
\label{eq:s2}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\sum_{\pm} \left(\frac{1}{x \mp a}\right) = \frac{2x}{x^2-a^2}
\label{eq:s3}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
